newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin extends fall on large offering.
newsitem.headline: KL tin extends fall on large offering.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down three cents at 14.23 ringgit ($5.73) a kg, extending last week's losses on continued large offering, traders said.
They noted initial offers for 151 tonnes against bids for 75. Final turnover was 126 tonnes, down from 137 on Friday.
"Some producers could be selling ahead of the Chinese New Year despite the lower prices," said one trader. A higher London Metal Exchange (LME) close on Friday failed to aid sentiment.
Buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia, traders said.
The local premium over LME narrowed to $35 a tonne against $70 previously.--Syed Azman (603-230 8911) ($1=2.4830 ringgit)
